items.title: Ed Allen Interview, 1961-01-14
items.q: Tooth Smith, Clarence Smith, Sarah Morton. ... So I used to go over there and play behind them.

ctx.x: See, one thing I wanted to ask you before I forget, how about the blues singers? You made records with some of the blues singers. I made quite a few of them.

Tooth Smith, Clarence Smith, Sarah Morton. I can't remember one of them. See, Clarence just recorded all those blues singers. So I used to go over there and play behind them. I made records, Jess Trumpet. Did you ever record with Ida Cox? No, I never recorded with Ida Cox. But you heard of her, huh? Yeah. She used to be in New York. But she's supposed to be coming back. That's good. I always see somebody get some money. I can't even think of all those blues singers. I mean, somebody, when you look in there, I…
What was the first time you played that style to a company of blues singers? Did you ever play any of that kind of music in St. Louis? In New Orleans or anything?
